text: The latest release for the Filament UI framework for Laravel, **v5.9.0**, was published on **September 26, 2026, at 19:40 UTC** [1]. This release is marked as the "Latest" on the official GitHub releases page and was made by user `@danharrin` [1]. While the major version **Filament v5** was initially released in **January 2026** to support Livewire v4 [2], [3], the Filament team planned to continue improving **v5** throughout **2026** [3], making **v5.9.0** a subsequent minor update within that major version.
